questions.passage: A few octopuses were found to collect coconut shells. They cleaned the shells with bursts of water, carried them to a new location, and piled them as a shelter. Traveling with the shells under their bodies forced them to walk slowly along the sea floor. This made the octopuses more exposed to predators. But it seems that they were willing to take that risk for greater future protection. The scientists who discovered the behavior argue that this is clear evidence of octopuses using tools.

questions.passage:
During the past few decades, scientists have begun to find more and more similarities between octopuses and humans. One of the most interesting ones is intelligence. The best evidence is their ability to camouflage themselves. Another sign is their use of tools. In the wild, they use stones to create walls to protect the entrances to their homes.

[요약문] Scientists have discovered that octopuses show signs of (A) _______ through their camouflage ability and their use of (B) _______.

<보기> intelligence / tools / poison / color / horror
questions.stem: 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말을 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오. (예: (A) ___, (B) ___)

det.korean: 문어는 위장 능력과 도구 사용을 통해 지능의 징후를 보인다. (A)=intelligence, (B)=tools.

questions.passage: Few scientists today deny that octopuses are intelligent animals. Perhaps it is time that we stopped thinking of them as alien creatures and acknowledged them as intelligent animals like us. There is still so much we do not know about the octopus. Aren't you curious about what is inside their mind?
